Rhode Island’s primary election is over — now it’s time to roll up our sleeves and dig in for the general election!
---
Every day, I’m proud to represent the place where I grew up with a charge to do everything I can to make life better.
---
I’m fighting for lower health care, housing, and utility costs, while working to expand economic opportunities.
---
I’ll keep calling out billionaires’ corruption and defend against attacks on our democracy.
---
We have to restore hope and optimism, and unlock an American Dream we can all afford.
---
But the stakes in November are bigger than one race.
---
With your help, Rhode Island can help send a clear message across the country: we have a strong mandate to get Washington working for all of us.
---
To do that, I need your help.

CA-45 is one of the seats national Republicans need to flip to maintain full control in Washington -- and after I won this district by just 653 votes in 2024, they've made no secret that they're coming after it harder than almost anywhere else in the country. I'm not going to pretend there's an easy path here. But "no choice" runs in my family. When my father fled Vietnam after the Fall of Saigon, his boat capsized, and he lost everything. He tried again anyway. The only way we hold this seat is the same way my family got here in the first place: by refusing to quit when quitting would've been so much easier. So thank you. Thank you for standing with me through every attack ad, every deadline, every ask. This fight is only possible because you keep choosing to be in it. **[We've beaten the odds before, and I know we can do it again, but only if we can match what they're spending against us. body:
We need to start this general election on the right foot.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/108337?refcode=em20260910-10896&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10896%2E614464%2Ec5ptST)
Hi Peter, it’s Chris Pappas.
**It’s official: I am the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate here in New Hampshire.**
I’m so grateful to every Granite Stater who put their trust in me and helped build this campaign together.
Growing up in Manchester and working alongside my family at our restaurant, I learned that you don’t get ahead just by making promises. You have to be accountable. You listen to people, work hard, and deliver.
That’s the same approach I’ve brought to Congress, and it’s why I’m running for the Senate.
I’m running to make New Hampshire more affordable for working families; protect Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid; safeguard reproductive freedom; and stand up for the small businesses that are the backbone of our communities.
**And now our general election fight against John Sununu officially begins.**
Political experts just changed this race to a Toss-up, Peter. The fact is: New Hampshire is a fiercely independent state, and this election could go either way. The country is watching, and the outcome here in New Hampshire will determine control of the U.S. Senate and what the next two years look like for millions of families across the country.
**[Peter, we are running a grassroots-powered campaign fueled by people like you. We need all hands on deck in order to keep New Hampshire blue and flip the Senate. Will you step up with $25 or whatever you can spare – split between me and Heartland Patriots – to boost our campaign as we enter the general election?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/108337?refcode=em20260910-10896&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=2&akid=10896%2E614464%2Ec5ptST)**

John Sununu has spent his career putting Washington and corporate special interests ahead of Granite Staters. While he was in Congress, he voted to give tax breaks to Big Pharma and Big Oil, and now he’s profiting off of investments in those same industries.
As we speak, national Republicans and dark-money groups are spending millions to put him back in the Senate because they know he’ll do the bidding of Trump and corporate interests, not look out for the people of New Hampshire.
**This race is a toss-up, so we need to join together right now and stay focused over the next eight weeks.**

subject: Inside Elections

body:
Inside Elections was the last major forecaster holding out on our race,
and they just shifted their prediction of the Alaska Senate race in our
direction.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260910-2-split.fYAMZO&refcode=em20260910-61804&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=61804%2E1407376%2EfOymBZ ]Image showing Inside Elections just shifted their prediction of the
Alaska Senate race in our direction.

They’re joining every other major election forecaster in recognizing that
the momentum is on our side. They know what we know: We are going to win
this race.

Alaskans are ready for change. I’ve spent the past nine months traveling
to communities in every corner of the state – from Prince of Wales to St.
Lawrence Island, the Kenai to the Arctic. And everywhere I go, I hear the
same thing: Enough.

Enough of Dan Sullivan’s self-dealing. He’s tripled his personal wealth
since getting to DC, and Alaskans are paying the price. We are getting
crushed by corporate greed while he turns the other way, and we’re tired
of it.

I’m angry that the millionaires and billionaires have rigged the system in
DC against working Alaskans. I’m angry that it doesn’t work for us
anymore. But I’m also optimistic. Alaskans are can-do people. And
together, on November 3rd, we’re going to take the first step toward
taking back our state.

We won nearly 50% of the vote in our open primary election last month,
against 15 other candidates of all parties – including incumbent Senator
Dan Sullivan.

More than 82,000 Alaskans cast their ballots in favor of our fish, family,
freedom campaign for a more abundant Alaska. We beat the incumbent by more
than 8 points, and in the first poll of the general election, we’re
leading Dan Sullivan by 1 point in the final round of ranked choice
voting.

Because while Alaskans are sending a clear message that we’re done with
the self-dealing politics of the past, we’re going up against the entire
DC establishment and their billionaire-backed super PACs – and they are
pummeling us with attack ads. They’re noticing the momentum that we’re
building in Alaska, and they’re spending BIG to stop us.

That’s why this race is so close. It’s the closest race in the country, a
true 50/50 toss-up! And while I feel confident that, in the end, we are
going to win, it isn’t going to be an easy fight. We are up against a
corrupt DC system, and they’re fighting with everything they have to keep
it that way.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260910-2-split.fYAMZO&refcode=em20260910-61804&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=61804%2E1407376%2EfOymBZ ]With that in mind, please split a donation between Demand Justice PAC
and my campaign for U.S. Senate today.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260910-2-split.fYAMZO&amount=5&refcode=em20260910-61804&t=1021&akid=61804%2E1407376%2EfOymBZ ]Donate $5 ››

I’m proud to be running a grassroots campaign. But it means that each and
every one of us has to chip in what we can, when we can, to help us win
this all-important race. For Alaska, and for the whole country.

Thank you for your support. It makes all the difference.

- Mary

I didn’t write this note quickly.

I typed it, stepped away from it, came back to it, and kept asking myself if I was saying this the right way.

Because what I’m asking of you is not small.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: What Trump was waiting for
body:
If we fall short, Trump’s Senate majority will be safe until 2029.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1490&source=&t=1&akid=3395%2E124072%2EcHiccL) | | | |

Hey, Peter, it's Roy Cooper.
Trump has been quietly holding $850 million back all year while Republicans wondered what he was waiting for. Now we know.
News just broke that a Trump-aligned super PAC will be investing in North Carolina’s Senate race. They’re doing whatever it takes to save his handpicked candidate, Michael Whatley.
This news is on top of everything else the GOP is doing to stop me:
**1.** JD Vance came to North Carolina to spread lies about me, Stephen Miller went on Fox News to rant and rave about me **and just last night, President Trump took to the GOP’s biggest stage to personally attack me.**
**2.** By the latest tally, Republicans are pouring close to $100 million into this race so far, which the Senate’s top GOP super PAC is using to go live with false attack ads against me.
**3\. Worst of all, their attacks are working: A recent poll shows that this race is statistically tied.**
The GOP is outspending us, and I need your help to fight back immediately so we can stay on track to flip this must-win seat. My team asked me to reach out to engaged supporters like you, so I’m personally asking:
[**_Peter, will you make your first donation to my U.S. Senate campaign in North Carolina so we can flip this seat and the Senate majority? When many of us were growing up, the stories we watched and read reinforced things like character, responsibility, and a basic understanding of where our country came from. Those stories weren't perfect--but they helped give us a sense of grounding.

Today, the media children are absorbing looks very different.

So much of what kids watch now either ignores America's history altogether or presents it in confusing and misleading ways. Children are forming their understanding of the world earlier than ever, and without a clear foundation, it's no wonder so many young adults today feel disconnected, uncertain, and adrift.

That's one of the reasons this project matters so much to me.

We're producing _Star Spangled Adventures: The Movie_ --a new film created specifically for children to help them understand America's story through engaging, clear, and inspiring storytelling. It's designed to be something families can watch together and trust.

As our nation approaches its 250th anniversary this year, I believe we have a responsibility to be intentional about the stories we pass on. What the next generation believes about our country, and about themselves, will be shaped by what they're taught today.

I'd like to invite you to take a simple pledge to stand with us.

When you take the pledge, you'll receive **exclusive behind-the-scenes sneak peeks of filming,** along with updates as the project moves forward and opportunities to help bring stories like this to life.

The pledge says:_I believe it is crucial to support projects like this to help raise a generation of children who understand and value the truth about our country --so that truth is not lost to the next generation._If that reflects what you believe, I hope you'll take a moment to sign the pledge and enjoy these exclusive behind-the-scenes sneak peeks of filming.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=3160%2E251025%2EifVTwH ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=3160%2E251025%2EifVTwH ]Abdul for US Senate

Peter,

MAGA Mike Rogers is supposed to be running for Senate in Michigan.

But he's got a mansion in Florida, where he moved after cashing in on the
corporations he used to regulate.

And tonight, he's in a third state entirely. Mike's in Dallas, Texas, for
Donald Trump's "MAGA Palooza" midterm convention.

[ Mike ]Mike and Trump

We've challenged Rogers to five debates across Michigan. He’s barely
agreed to two. But Trump throws a party in Dallas, and Mike's on the first
flight out.

That's the whole Mike Rogers story of this election. Whatever Trump wants,
Mike does. Trump starts a trade war, and Mike calls the tariffs
"masterful." Michigan families have lost $5,619 on average to those trade
wars, more than any state in the country, and Mike's big response to
grocery prices was "Oh my gosh, coffee went up... You know, horror!"

So why fly to Texas to lick Trump's boots in person? Because it pays.

Trump handpicked Mike for this race, and now Trump's personal super PAC is
putting more than $15 million behind him. That's more money than any
candidate in the country is getting. Stack it on top of the $51 million
the GOP's Senate Leadership Fund has committed to Michigan, and you get a
clear picture of who Mike actually works for. (Hint: not you.)

Peter, working
people across Michigan are sick and tired of where Trump is taking this
state and this country. Rising costs, inflation, wars nobody asked for.
Michiganders know exactly who is picking their pockets.

Unfortunately, being right doesn't win elections by itself. This race is
tied right now. And if Trump and Rogers outspend us this badly, they can
bury Abdul under attack ads before most Michiganders ever hear from him
directly. So we’re asking for your help:

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260910-3-ak.SS8-nu&amount=10&refcode=em20260910-3159&t=1004&akid=3160%2E251025%2EifVTwH ]Can you chip in $10 or whatever you can to help us repel
Trump's $15 million and keep Abdul on the air in Michigan?

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260910-3-ak.SS8-nu&amount=10&refcode=em20260910-3159&t=1023&akid=3160%2E251025%2EifVTwH ]Donate $10 ››

Mike Rogers spent today in Dallas. We spent it getting Abdul in front of
as many Michiganders as we can.

In solidarity,

Team Abdul

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Emails like this help us stay connected with grassroots supporters like you, so thank you for taking the time to read this message. To contribute via check, please address it to Abdul for U.S. Senate, PO Box 126, St. Clair Shores, MI 48080.

Now, on to some important updates: I’m proud to be a co-chair of the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee’s Red Alert program for the midterms this year. Every two weeks from now through Election Day, the program is highlighting 10 Democrats who really need our support. Marcy Kaptur (OH-09), in a seat Donald Trump won by 11 points. This is the third time Republicans have redrawn Rep. Kaptur’s district to benefit themselves, but she can win if she has the resources to reach new constituents on the phone, at the doors, and on TV! Dr. Amish Shah (AZ-01) is an emergency room physician who came within just 4% of flipping this district in 2024 — one of the closest margins of the 2024 cycle. With less than two months until the midterms, Trump is pulling out every stop to buy this election.

Peter, just when I thought he couldn’t stoop any lower:
**Trump just pledged to send every American $5,000 after the midterms _if_ Republicans maintain control of the House and Senate.** Yes, you heard that right. An American President just offered a bribe to voters in order to keep his grip on power.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260910_2_trump.6t6v56&refcode=em20260910-3996&t=2&akid=3996%2E587540%2EcXVH-D)

All we need to ask ourselves is, why is Trump doing this now? Because Republicans are watching people like Zohran Mamdani win by actually delivering – free buses, frozen rent, real fights for working people. That's popular. Republicans have nothing like it. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: I’m speechless, Peter.
body:
This is it. This is the moment we’ve been waiting for.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, look at this:
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260910_4_poll.6ngb5q&refcode=em20260910-2078&amount=5&t=1&akid=2078%2E299639%2EYpynm0)In June, we were down 6 points. In August, down 1. Today, a brand-new Univision poll has this race TIED. 47-47.

On the road again
| | | | | | [ ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M275HGX015YQE6M1EK03G4YC_0)
---
| **Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, information and upcoming events.**

|
---
| | |
---
|
### **LET'S KEEP RIDING FOR WYOMING!**
---
| Folks, what a few weeks it has been!Kelly and I are still humbled by the support Wyoming showed us in the primary. A win like that takes a whole lot of people doing a whole lot of things from knocking doors, making calls, putting up signs, hosting events, talking with neighbors and, most importantly, voting. Thank you to everyone who helped us get here.We didn’t spend much time sitting still. After some necessary work at the ranch, we got right back to it.The day after the primary, we launched our Wyoming Healthcare Strike Team. Since then, we’ve been back on the road. From listening and learning about career and technical education in Gillette, to firefighters in Riverton, conversations in Jackson and Wyoming traditions in Kaycee. It’s the same thing we’ve done from the beginning: show up, listen and do the work.The primary was a big step, but there is plenty ahead. I want to keep talking with the folks who supported me and the folks who didn’t. We may not agree on everything, but I think there is a lot we can get done when we listen to one another and stay focused on Wyoming.Kelly and I are grateful to have you riding with us.Eric
---
| **In Case You Missed It...**
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**After Victory, Barlow Gets To Work Immediately to Launch Healthcare Strike Team** GILLETTE, WY — Eric Barlow wasted no time getting to work on his campaign promises. After a successful bid in the Wyoming Republican gubernatorial primary, Barlow launched a platform for his Healthcare Strike Team.The Strike Team will convene healthcare stakeholders throughout Wyoming to advise and deliver actionable recommendations for day one of the Barlow administration.“On January 4th, I want to have specific action items that my administration can tackle to make healthcare better in Wyoming. We can’t solve healthcare on day one, but I will take consistent, meaningful steps to improve healthcare in Wyoming.”Barlow continued, “Wyoming has many people interested in improving healthcare. Wyoming’s providers, hospitals, payers, and patients are informed and engaged. The Strike Team will take in all perspectives, parse out the priorities, and identify who can deliver results: the State of Wyoming, local governments, the Wyoming legislature, federal government, private sector, or a combination of all five.”Barlow will spend time in the coming months meeting with stakeholders who offer varying perspectives on healthcare in Wyoming, while continuing to campaign and prepare for the general election on November 3rd. Those with ideas or interest can visit [barlowforwyo.com/healthcare](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M275HGX015YQE6M1EK03G4YC_1), local input is essential to how the team can help communities across the state.The Healthcare Strike Team will include more than healthcare providers and patients. Barlow said he will also seek out business leaders who provide health insurance to their employees, local governments, and economic development offices to understand community priorities with healthcare.“I have engaged with people who have valuable perspectives on healthcare. Those conversations emphasized that the people you want in the room largely depend on the problem you are trying to solve. We all know there are challenges but we also know there are opportunities. Now it is time to prioritize which ones we will tackle first.”Barlow and his team will review work already underway by other groups, the legislature, and the Wyoming Department of Health.“Wyoming has spent a lot of time studying healthcare, and there are good ideas already on the table. We will look closely at that work, so we champion the best ideas and solutions.”That review will include WY We Care, the state’s ongoing effort focused on mental health issues, as well as the Wyoming Legislature’s Task Force on Health Insurance Affordability. Barlow will also review HB 122, the Wyoming Rural Health Transformation Sustainability, Accountability and Fiscal Protection Act, which passed the Wyoming Legislature last legislative session.“Governor Gordon, Senator Barrasso, legislative leadership, and the Wyoming Department of Health worked hard to create Wyoming’s response to the federal Rural Health Transformation Program (RHT). Wyoming’s Year 1 grant application was approved in May for over $200 million. We will be good stewards of those funds and engage now to ensure future requests maximize their benefits to Wyoming. The RHT is a five-year program, and the funding available to our state could be truly impactful along with other actions Wyoming steps up with through our Strike Team efforts.”

| **On The Trail**
---
| | | **GILLETTE** Kelly and I recently toured Gillette College’s Career Technical Education (CTE) programs, and spent time talking (and learning!) with CTE instructors, as well as spending time with students from area schools who were getting a closer look at critical trades occupations.Gillette College’s CTE impact is easy to see, with their efforts supporting one out of every 62 jobs in Campbell County.More than 60 CDL drivers have earned their licenses through the CDL program, and their electrical students have a 93% first-time pass rate on the state journeyman test, the highest in Wyoming.Students who attend CTE programs are preparing for careers in welding, diesel technology, machining, industrial electrical, nursing, engineering and other high-demand fields.
---
| | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
| **KAYCEE**

It’s been eleven years and counting for the annual Wagon Fest in Kaycee. Ten carefully restored sheep wagons, a great crowd and one heck of a lamb and steak fry. A good Wyoming tradition and a fine day spent together.
---
|
---
| | | **JACKSON**

We spent a wonderful evening at Hotel Jackson, visiting with folks on their new rooftop patio and sharing a good meal at FIGS.Earlier in the day, we had a conversation about civics and the part each of us plays in shaping Wyoming’s future. Many people talked about how grateful they are to see Wyoming people coming together as a community.That’s how we get things done in this state: we show up, listen to one another and find a way forward together.Thank you to everyone who joined us and to the folks at Hotel Jackson for having us
---

| **RIVERTON** It was an honor to be in Riverton for the Wyoming Firefighters Hall of Fame induction and Fallen Firefighters Memorial Service.Congratulations to Kim Lee of the Riverton Fire Department and Rob Akers of the Weston County Fire District on a well-earned honor. We also remembered those who gave their lives in service, including Don Bodine of Evanston Fire and EMS, whose name was added to the memorial this year.Wyoming’s firefighters show up when we need them most. Today was a chance to show up for them.

It matched what we saw and heard over the past year, but it’s something else to see it through your votes.We’re headed to the General Election in November on a strong wave of support, and we are already back to work! There is plenty ahead of us before November.Thank you for your trust. Let’s keep working for Wyoming.

Rochelle Gateway Center, 222 S 22nd St, LaramieSeptember 18, 10:00-10:45 am, Tour Downtown Clinic, 611 S 2nd St, LaramieSeptember 18, 11:00-11:45 am, Tour Laramie Soup Kitchen, 104 S 4th St Suite 101, Laramie September 18, 2:30-3:45 pm, Rave Aerospace, 2212 Cumulus Dr, LaramieSeptember 18, 4:00-6:00 pm, Laramie Meet & Greet, Bond's Brewing Company, 411 S 2nd St, LaramieSeptember 19, 6:15-9:00 pm, Patron’s Ball, Buffalo Bill Center of the West, Cody | On The Trail | | | GILLETTE Kelly and I recently toured Gillette College’s Career Technical Education (CTE) programs, and spent time talking (and learning!) with CTE instructors, as well as spending time with students from area schools who were getting a closer look at critical trades occupations.Gillette College’s CTE impact is easy to see, with their efforts supporting one out of every 62 jobs in Campbell County.More than 60 CDL drivers have earned their licenses through the CDL program, and their electrical students have a 93% first-time pass rate on the state journeyman test, the highest in Wyoming.Students who attend CTE programs are preparing for careers in welding, diesel technology, machining, industrial electrical, nursing, engineering and other high-demand fields. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | KAYCEE It’s been eleven years and counting for the annual Wagon Fest in Kaycee. Ten carefully restored sheep wagons, a great crowd and one heck of a lamb and steak fry. A good Wyoming tradition and a fine day spent together. | | | | JACKSON We spent a wonderful evening at Hotel Jackson, visiting with folks on their new rooftop patio and sharing a good meal at FIGS.Earlier in the day, we had a conversation about civics and the part each of us plays in shaping Wyoming’s future. Many people talked about how grateful they are to see Wyoming people coming together as a community.That’s how we get things done in this state: we show up, listen to one another and find a way forward together.Thank you to everyone who joined us and to the folks at Hotel Jackson for having us | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | RIVERTON It was an honor to be in Riverton for the Wyoming Firefighters Hall of Fame induction and Fallen Firefighters Memorial Service.Congratulations to Kim Lee of the Riverton Fire Department and Rob Akers of the Weston County Fire District on a well-earned honor. We also remembered those who gave their lives in service, including Don Bodine of Evanston Fire and EMS, whose name was added to the memorial this year.Wyoming’s firefighters show up when we need them most. Today was a chance to show up for them. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | STATEWIDE ELECTION NIGHT WIN!We committed over the last year to show up and do the work, then asked Wyoming to do the same on Aug. 18. And WOW, you certainly did. Thank you to everyone who voted.Kelly and I are so grateful for the support we received from across the state. It matched what we saw and heard over the past year, but it’s something else to see it through your votes.We’re headed to the General Election in November on a strong wave of support, and we are already back to work! There is plenty ahead of us before November.Thank you for your trust. Let’s keep working for Wyoming. | | | | | | Wyoming’s strength has always come from neighbors pitching in. With battlegrounds all across the country, you might be surprised to learn that I just can’t take my eyes off of Iowa. Seriously!

The _National Journal_ said Rob Sand **_“might be the strongest Democrat running statewide anywhere in the country this cycle,”_** and listed Iowa on their list of 10 most flippable governor’s races.

My decades of experience are telling me the same thing, Peter. [**It would be foolish to take our eye off the prize now, which is why I’m asking you to help him win this governor’s race today. Will you split a $25 donation between Blue Amp Action and Rob Sand’s campaign to help him take on culture warrior Zach Lahn?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/15159?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.09.11_Sand-Carville_B1_F1_S2_C1_180AC-360DON_T2&t=5&akid=3077%2E259176%2E9cszrQ) | [DONATE $25 >>](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/15159?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.09.11_Sand-Carville_B1_F1_S2_C1_180AC-360DON_T2&t=6&akid=3077%2E259176%2E9cszrQ)

**_Recent polling shows Rob leading this race._**

I don’t need to tell you what a big deal this is, Peter.

The partisans running the show for the last decade have underfunded public schools, endangered folks’ health care, closed rural hospitals, and watched as jobs, opportunities, and people leave Iowa to go elsewhere.

Look, we’ve been burned by Iowa before, but polling and on-the-ground sentiment is that Iowans are ready for something better.

**Rob Sand is the best candidate — _and perhaps the only one_ — who can speak to the concerns of everyday Iowans, regardless of their political leanings.**

Derek, Donald Trump's FCC just threatened ABC over an interview with Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico. **This is the second time in seven months that Trump's hand-picked FCC Chair has tried to silence James.** **[We can't let these attacks go unanswered. Please split a donation of $10 between James' campaign and mine to help James spread his message and flip Texas blue.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7979?t=14&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_091126_talarico&akid=10330%2E5257348%2E61OR7F)** | | [SPLIT A DONATION→](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7979?t=15&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_091126_talarico&akid=10330%2E5257348%2E61OR7F)

Here's how this all panned out.
This week, James was scheduled to appear on Jimmy Kimmel's program. That is, until Trump's FCC suggested the host and the network would face repercussions for carrying the interview.
So Kimmel took it to YouTube instead.
The same thing happened back in February to James. CBS lawyers pressured Colbert to pull down its interview with him over fears of crossing the FCC.

Trump's FCC will go after anyone — comedians, journalists, television show hosts — who say things they don't like or give airtime to individuals they deem political opponents.

| | Friends,
I am so lucky to have former Michigan Attorneys General Mike Cox and Bill Schuette by my side and helping me in this race. They know what it takes to be Attorney General and understand the responsibility the AG has to keep the public's trust.
[Will you join them in helping us win in November by donating to our campaign?](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tU2YtM-CoVoaEmQ-GyhbkYYpoL-jL3jzJRawFEZyW1I0RTE0juZmN9GNPbzOoet5fmH5s_YA_wNOsjlRnYzJBdZhA7PMvbTA-LlU5CXWhcwfYWQUJmBeIJ1qL4sVl4l43B1sUGpUkba2fzjYo9NNNObca7JIF9GziSuZKjpSyX-8j4HL1G_kOR03vblPdpMMI-nKlRBU1e4y1-KFR15DaOCJr0TtgZ66&c=z9v16K7LN0oM_lFZncQsefYF298V5hT-GwtPolHeh2vMAb4H9PKpXg==&ch=xs5KxR-P68F9sqWGXBB0xC5Om3qxz3SCC8q1gqSb733dEHyw-AQUAQ==)
Earlier this week, Mike and Bill laid out why Washtenaw County Prosecutor Eli Savit lacks the ethical fitness to be Michigan's next Attorney General. As Washtenaw's Prosecutor, Savit has repeatedly abused the public's trust.
First, while serving as Washtenaw's prosecutor, Eli Savit was also working for a law firm in the private sector and refused to disclose his income from this second job.
Savit is also currently a defendant in [a federal lawsuit](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tU2YtM-CoVoaEmQ-GyhbkYYpoL-jL3jzJRawFEZyW1I0RTE0juZmN0ry6Uto1vjOD0KBwYu48IjNa6UhqN_EXSRUb2Bk0ycqMGGJ2QIP0z1TqVCvr5JtSN1eeZ4XkeYt0EuuFZgyX_9_XtlA_MIlVK6kIBl5c2L_2saydY4Wo75DNu2Mjl87Tyhp1SJwP_UH3qoXxmVgNt3c-SRtu5LuVi1Orp0qwBodDvrx2mTB8jomfbCaH_OjiR9qk71gYOqIXiHiZqPB67lkgGGFlezey_gv_N2l7KY2ocHBDUfCVfqs8FJ2zY7zzqhG2GNddXNVS97HJOsuxttfg86YuimDMD8rXmVjeEsjPr4sBEyRiP-jAullTqymNZQVq31SX20qpPRcjwbcTUdab1GVZ-WRpWd1qktgsxUI7Z3NUWQ6Cqplef-hJxrOa6ngoRYai2LE3PJ1I_oda4RpQZISAObMm4r-sQ5c2EwFouxWde3Rdr8DkNg0y2zWyqeiML4P3UaK&c=z9v16K7LN0oM_lFZncQsefYF298V5hT-GwtPolHeh2vMAb4H9PKpXg==&ch=xs5KxR-P68F9sqWGXBB0xC5Om3qxz3SCC8q1gqSb733dEHyw-AQUAQ==) filed by a former staffer that alleges Savit suspended and placed them under investigation after they filed a complaint against a subordinate.
Savit, who famously legalized magic mushrooms when he announced he would not charge individuals with crimes over psychedelic drugs, has [taken thousands of dollars](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tU2YtM-CoVoaEmQ-GyhbkYYpoL-jL3jzJRawFEZyW1I0RTE0juZmN0ry6Uto1vjOCiidwfEmGKxnd2Kz1Gxd6S2jUYZNMV8GaiXpA7Meq12aUgNsxruQI22DZXkLHinyQD7iqbhLa1Y0TozLHjReTMKzGzXL_xXEhLpdvQeooTU2bKWOg4c1qG_Z1tq5NE57byk-IZJM7fFafdXyduuNsvDurgRvKYWpEMdTFFN6uwJ0FGKG7tAnyOUdfYO5dI-hLCRGQeaoexgWEucINIAFTWofISpv2pTOhIDLwmg3wEfrkyhdGx5DrkBClipPIBiDC5krI_qI-tgKlEeJBDuJnfYWMWBTIY3rAX7IpI5oe3YZH6WZvpwjZNIU_aQQqS3yC7BKMrBLBffQdv8c4RPIgYGrh_TSigdx0YENN_3zU11C17xTD4mAu6U0xvW0ksGd7cmgw1NVXzsyVz0Jc6F4hRnTFzGiNORjWZ-feCDdVAZbE_TfB_qjwo_m1VNhp2pkCBYnTg4qXawze7DadtculIp75QylAzgm&c=z9v16K7LN0oM_lFZncQsefYF298V5hT-GwtPolHeh2vMAb4H9PKpXg==&ch=xs5KxR-P68F9sqWGXBB0xC5Om3qxz3SCC8q1gqSb733dEHyw-AQUAQ==) from an Ann Arbor individual who sells the narcotic.
Not only has the mushroom dealer donated to Savit's campaign, he contributed one of only two donations last year to a political action committee tied to Savit.
Is this mushroom dealer counting on this policy to be taken statewide under Savit so he can expand his business?
Finally, Savit is currently under investigation by Secretary of State, and Democrat nominee for Governor, Jocelyn Benson for repeatedly using a taxpayer-funded gas card and vehicle for travel as he campaigns for Attorney General. name: Marsha Blackburn
subject: A day we must never forget.
body:
Twenty-five years ago today.

| | | | | | Peter,
Today, let us pause to honor the innocent lives taken from us twenty-five years ago.
September 11, 2001, remains permanently etched into our national memory. It was a morning that began like any other, only to become a day of unimaginable heartbreak as terror struck our homeland.
Twenty-five years later, we continue to stand beside the families who carry the weight of that loss every single day.
We remain forever grateful to the heroes who stepped up in our nation's hour of greatest need - the first responders, service members, and everyday Americans who defied fear, ran toward danger, and put love of country and neighbor above all else.
In our darkest hour, we discovered an unshakable unity forged in patriotism, faith, and a shared devotion to freedom. As twenty-five years turn into the next generation, we renew our solemn promise to defend the freedoms we cherish and to preserve the spirit of patriotism that brought us together in the days following that terrible attack.
We must never forget.
God bless you, and God bless the United States of America.
Marsha Blackburn

Six days after America marks 25 years since Islamic terrorists murdered nearly 3,000 people on September 11, 2001, George Washington University in Washington, D.C. will open its doors to a two-day conference dedicated to the proposition that the real villain of the last quarter century is the United States, and that jihadists and their sympathizers around the world are the real victims of 9/11.

The event, titled ["Weekend of Resistance: 25 Years Of The War On Terror,"](https://substack.com/redirect/719d7f5d-5d4c-4d5b-83d5-00314e5c0769?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is scheduled for September 17 and 18 at GW's Elliott School of International Affairs, a few blocks from the White House. It is organized by a group called the Muslim Counterpublics Lab, and is being co-sponsored by GW's own Institute for Middle East Studies, whose director, Dr. Melani McAlister, is slated to deliver the opening remarks alongside the Lab's founder, Dr. Maha Hilal.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0936e253-0350-4cb4-8de3-790f46ca35b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/219e2388-dccd-4fab-a984-1b6389a76845?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The organizers are not subtle about their purpose. According to the conference's own description, the goal is to _" imagine a future where infrastructure of the War on Terror is finally abolished"_ and to _" demand accountability, justice and reparations."_ The United States, in their telling, deploys _" Islamophobia and xenophobia"_ to _" manufacture consent"_ for _" campaigns of ethnic cleansing, genocide, occupation, and extractivism."_ A lunchtime panel is titled "State Violence by Design: Anti-Indigenous Racism, Anti-Blackness and the Historical Legacy of Amerikkka." Another is called "Who's the Terrorist?"
There's not a single word on the conference website about the men, women and children who were incinerated in the Twin Towers, crushed at the Pentagon, or who fought back the hijackers over a field in Shanksville, Pennsylvania. The ["About" page](https://substack.com/redirect/719d7f5d-5d4c-4d5b-83d5-00314e5c0769?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) mentions September 11 exactly once, as the date nine days before President Bush _" gave a speech to Congress announcing the launch of the War on Terror."_ The 2,977 people murdered by al-Qaeda that morning do not exist in this conference's universe. The only victims the organizers intend to _" mourn and remember"_ are what they call _" the millions of victims of the War on Terror."_
Then there is the [lineup](https://substack.com/redirect/04969dbd-d4a7-4083-84e1-414f38759f5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

---|---|---
Friday morning's centerpiece is a plenary titled "We Refuse to Be Silent: Testimonies of Survivors and Political Prisoners Post 9/11." The "survivors" GW is putting on stage include Mansoor Adayfi, who spent more than 14 years in Guantanamo Bay before being transferred to Serbia in 2016 and who now works as the "Guantanamo Project coordinator" for CAGE, the British advocacy group whose research director infamously [described ISIS executioner "Jihadi John"](https://substack.com/redirect/6786bf31-fdd1-4bf7-b580-efb1be74cc42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as "a beautiful young man."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..PAMkH2FT7CS0PPhNMo_Ko6vf-RaL5BFjPehlSbPRWMc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=214911979)
Sharing the stage with him is Nida Abu Baker, whose conference bio explains that her advocacy began with _" the unjust incarceration of her father, Shukri Abu Baker of the Holy Land Five."_ Shukri Abu Baker was the CEO of the Holy Land Foundation, which a federal jury in Dallas found had funneled more than $12 million to Hamas. He was [sentenced to 65 years in federal prison](https://substack.com/redirect/987d5ce9-5ac0-47ec-a658-a61d9913376d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2009 in what remains the largest terrorism financing prosecution in American history.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9cf7f272-44f7-4f14-a12c-db84484f11f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Also on the panel: Mariam Abu-Ali, a Northern Virginia native and Georgetown graduate who has spent years writing about her brother Ahmed, whom she calls _" a US political prisoner."_ Her brother is Ahmed Omar Abu Ali, who was [convicted in 2005](https://substack.com/redirect/44d00ac8-b63b-4dde-a823-23f76cf420a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of joining an al-Qaeda cell in Saudi Arabia and conspiring to assassinate President George W. Bush. He is serving life in prison at the federal Supermax in Colorado. GW is presenting his sister to its students as a "survivor."
The conference's closing plenary features Kairi Al-Amin, whose bio proudly identifies him as the son of "Imam Jamil Al-Amin fka H. Rap Brown." Jamil Al-Amin was [convicted in 2002 of murdering Fulton County Sheriff's Deputy Ricky Kinchen](https://substack.com/redirect/c01a8556-fc08-4ad7-8786-2521ad3bb876?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who was shot while trying to serve a warrant. Al-Amin died in federal prison last November. His son's bio describes the case as _" the unlawful but complete destruction of an innocent man."_
The opening plenary is headlined by Alka Pradhan, the defense lawyer for [Ammar al-Baluchi](https://substack.com/redirect/1ba827f9-2f3d-4b3d-88f0-6f310ecbbd29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Khalid Sheikh Mohammed's nephew and one of the five men charged at Guantanamo with plotting the September 11 attacks. She will be joined by Baher Azmy of the Center for Constitutional Rights, who represents Mahmoud Khalil, the Columbia University agitator the Trump administration moved to deport. Other panelists include Steve Downs, co-founder of the Coalition for Civil Freedoms, an organization that advocates on behalf of people convicted in federal terrorism cases, and a "Movement Attorney" from Project South moderating a session on "Palestine" that describes Israel as a "settler state" carrying out "genocide."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b79cbf4d-d365-44bc-a519-5aef8a770d06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This is who George Washington University has decided to platform just days after 9/11 in the same month our nation relives burying its dead for the 25th time.
The Muslim Counterpublics Lab founded in 2022 by Hilal, describes itself as a _" radical discursive space focused on combating systems of oppression rooted in Islamophobia."_ Hilal is the author of a book called _Innocent Until Proven Muslim_ , the title of which is also the name of Friday morning's opening session. The Lab has [called for dismantling the Department of Homeland Security](https://substack.com/redirect/695591b9-42cf-4261-96b8-b6e230f3f20f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and defunding ICE and Customs and Border Protection, and Hilal has compared Israel's response to the October 7 Hamas massacre to America's response to 9/11, calling both a pretext for "genocidal war." This is not a scholarly institute. It is a jihadist and communist activist machine whose founding premise is that the American response to the deadliest terrorist attack on US soil was the real crime.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/528173ec-c27f-48a8-b195-604b440ef9b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
GW has a long history of promoting and platforming Islamic jihadists and their supporters. In 2001, the same year al-Qaeda struck, Anwar al-Awlaki was a part-time doctoral student at GW's Graduate School of Education and served as an [assistant to the university's Muslim chaplain](https://substack.com/redirect/b7a47758-0fee-4a81-9a1d-5fe2eb9bb48a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on its Interfaith Board of Chaplains, a fact GW's own spokeswoman confirmed to the student newspaper in 2010. His education was funded, in part, by USAID. Awlaki, who the 9/11 Commission found had contact with two of the hijackers at his Northern Virginia mosque, went on to become al-Qaeda's most effective English-language recruiter, inspiring the Fort Hood shooter and the underwear bomber before he was killed in a U.S. drone strike in 2011. A quarter century later, GW is once again lending its campus and its name to people who believe the Islamic terrorists were the real victims of 9/11.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cfca8775-4503-4436-b719-6310843d1257?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/eea79a6f-59f0-49f8-82f3-d85fe71af648?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Jihadists find an open and engaged audience at GW. For three years, the university has been a showcase for the same ideology the conference will promote. In the fall of 2023, just weeks after October 7, GW students [projected "Glory to our martyrs"](https://substack.com/redirect/506c35ac-087d-4cd1-9047-a09e9e3529bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) onto the side of Gelman Library, the main campus library. In April 2024, protesters seized University Yard for two weeks, and a demonstrator was [photographed holding a "final solution" banner](https://substack.com/redirect/9eedc3f1-2990-49f9-ac48-9fd2901ce734?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Over the following days they draped the statue of George Washington in a keffiyeh and Palestinian flags, projected "Long Live The Student Intifada" onto campus buildings, and [chanted "Guillotine, guillotine"](https://substack.com/redirect/eddbbd0a-8982-43f6-9f67-263bb17ad53f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the university's president and provost by name. It took D.C. police, pepper spray and more than 30 arrests to clear them out at 3 a.m. on May 8, 2024.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/318313ed-19e1-4f81-b4dd-9a1dfc473f03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[](https://substack.com/redirect/43ce502c-3212-4c85-9522-ebdcdbef5904?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Within hours of the belated raid, the school [ringed University Yard with metal fencing](https://substack.com/redirect/87b0c195-27a9-46a2-93f5-5660b81e4291?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), then [barricaded Kogan Plaza and Anniversary Park](https://substack.com/redirect/960422b9-de1e-4563-ba1e-0c4ae0c4e46a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as well, citing _" heightened safety concerns related to the recent illegal demonstrations."_ University Yard is the main campus Quad. In December 2024 GW replaced the temporary barriers with permanent fencing and gates, and administrators have [locked those gates](https://substack.com/redirect/6d06482c-e7e9-4fbf-ad03-53654ead3885?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) whenever a protest cropped up on campus, shutting the entire community out of the quad. GW's own security page, since scrubbed, explained that fencing was _" the most effective way to prevent large numbers of non-GW-affiliated demonstrators from joining an attempted encampment, living on GW property, and disrupting our university operations."_ Student government passed a resolution begging for the fences to come down. Instead, this summer GW tore out the old fence and is [installing a new, nicer one](https://substack.com/redirect/6d06482c-e7e9-4fbf-ad03-53654ead3885?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that "aesthetically integrates" with the campus, with the work due to finish in early August, just in time for the fall semester and this conference.
More than two years after the disgusting and embarrassing encampment, GW still has to fence its own students off their own quad, not to protect them from some outside threat, but to keep them and the outside agitators they invite in from reoccupying the campus and going back to intimidating Jewish classmates in the name of the "intifada". That is the student body the Muslim Counterpublics Lab will be addressing when it explains how the "terrorism paradigm" is a tool of "Amerikkka" and that the families of convicted terrorists are the real victims.
GW does all of this while accepting massive federal funding - your tax dollars. The university reported [$227 million in externally funded research](https://substack.com/redirect/30c72da1-6b80-4d66-a96a-fe60fc2bd7e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the 2023-24 academic year, much of it from federal agencies, on top of a $3.4 billion endowment.
On August 12, 2025, the Justice Department [formally found](https://substack.com/redirect/09d61d9d-c5a1-4289-bbbf-9a312985ad53?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that GW violated Title VI of the Civil Rights Act by acting with _" deliberate indifference"_ toward antisemitic harassment of Jewish and Israeli students and faculty. _" No one is above the law,"_ Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon said at the time, _" and universities that promulgate antisemitic discrimination will face legal consequences."_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/64076b8e-423f-4d80-9e9e-7acdbeb63bd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
While on notice from the Justice Department, GW's administration thought it would be a good idea to co-sponsor an event that brands Israel a genocidal "settler state," America as "Amerikkka," and the families of convicted terrorists as survivors of American oppression. The Trump Administration should cut off every federal dollar flowing to George Washington University.
This isn't the only event in the US that seems to celebrate the perpetrators of Islamic terror. As Loomer Unleashed [reported last week](https://substack.com/redirect/1109a3e6-d443-46e1-b12d-1c9d7b171059?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Muslim Michigan Democrat Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is throwing a "Mexican fiesta" themed campaign party on the 25th anniversary of 9/11 itself, and the Democrats' [entire midterm message](https://substack.com/redirect/85e0abb4-f73b-43e9-9f11-33c477bf9e32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has been about impeachment, communism and Islam.
Meanwhile, at Guantanamo Bay, a military judge ruled on August 29 that Khalid Sheikh Mohammed's confessions to the FBI cannot be used against him, with the 9/11 mastermind's trial not scheduled until 2028. Why hasn't KSM been given the death penalty already?
Twenty-five years ago, Islamic terrorists flew planes into buildings full of Americans. This September, a university across the river from the Pentagon, next to the US Department of State, will host a conference whose organizers cannot bring themselves to mention it because they sympathize with and support Islamic jihad.
Never forget means never forget who carried out these Islamic terrorist attacks that murdered 3,000 Americans, and it means we must never forget who spent the next 25 years making excuses for them.

Peter,Twenty-five years ago, our nation was shaken to its core by an unthinkable act of terror. Nearly 3,000 innocent lives were taken that day, but amid the devastation, we witnessed the very best of America.Brave first responders, ordinary citizens, and countless heroes stepped forward with courage and compassion, a spirit that continues to inspire us all.Like many of you, I remember exactly where I was when I first heard the news. That moment profoundly changed how I saw life, service, and responsibility.I felt a compelling call to act, leaving behind my business, leisure, and even time with my family to serve in the United States Air Force.Through that experience, I understood the weight of service and sacrifice, not only in my decision but in the courage of countless others who stepped forward that day.It was a powerful reminder that the impact of such moments extends beyond any one life, shaping how we stand together and remain united in the face of great trials.Let us pause today to remember the lives lost on that tragic day, honor the courage of those who answered the call to protect and serve, and reaffirm our unity as a Nation in the face of adversity.We will never forget.With gratitude,Troy Downing (MT-02)

name: Congressman Tim Burchett
subject: Twenty-five years later, we remember
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Burchett for Congress
body:
Honoring those we lost, those who answered the call, and those who still carry the weight of that day.

| [](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._ZJRYMi2vdyIslQ)
---
Peter,
Twenty-five years ago today, America changed forever.
We all remember where we were when the world seemed to stop. We remember the quiet horror, the smoke against a clear blue sky, and the awful realization that our country was under attack.
On September 11, 2001, nearly 3,000 innocent people were taken from us. Today, we remember them, pray for the families who still carry that loss, and honor the extraordinary courage shown in one of our nation’s darkest hours.
Firefighters climbed stairwells while others were fleeing. Police officers and first responders ran toward danger. Ordinary Americans risked, and in many cases gave, their lives to save people they had never met.
And in the years that followed, another generation of Americans raised their hands to defend this country.
I’ve said it before, and I mean it with all my heart: I owe everything I have in this life, but my salvation, to the men and women who wear our country’s uniform.
Their service and sacrifice are something we should never take for granted.
So today, I hope you’ll join me in remembering those we lost, praying for the families they left behind, and thanking every American who answered the call to serve in the days, months, and years that followed.
Twenty-five years later, our duty remains the same: honor their memory, remember their sacrifice, and never forget what happened that day.
May God bless them, and may God continue to bless the United States of America.
Thank y’all for the honor of serving you,Congressman Tim Burchett (R-TN)

September 11th, 2001, was a day that froze time for many, as the surreal events solidified into reality with the destruction of the second tower.
Every year I'm reminded of that moment. I'm reminded that there are always those who seek to extinguish the flame of liberty that lives within each and every one of us-embodied in the imperfect country we all love so much that we demand and work tirelessly for its perfection. But I know there is no act of terrorism or catastrophic event that the American people can't overcome.
Today we remember those lost, and we honor their lives by carrying that flame into the future with absolute resolve.
NEVER FORGET.

name: Bill Gray
subject: Have you noticed
body:
Confident claims, especially with talking heads on television...quick reactions in comments online...everyone with strong opinions but not always clear thinking.

This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkcFq3DAURb9G3tlITx5bXmhRqhkoNCkliy6NIr2xH8iSsKQp-fuSknxAtufCuVzun6f1yVKguD3bAzWVsvrk190-8C21mCo59CtwmHq-9EKs1lV64DrazusLCHVXHWoxq0WAgvnS7RqFuoCdnL17yXFxr0qOVi0L3oWUE7cd6XcfX4QQwEcJg_MLTLgoUP51BAA28pa9rThQLOSxuJRyToEquTKkc-uC3mvNhclvDG4MbhTvadgphOJtwAF9Y3ALaSPXnzvWdJLrS23-rd8aeWTyVhyThsM882cOI_y8GvPLXK_fGUytHmtJ7XTIpMlnKhldpbh9RAd6ageTBg9L4QM6e2RLW2TS_K_9xClWjJVJ83vuf7y89J_Lu1P7_JdCoDLNbOTbu2tw6ejql054aPgXAAD__wb6kko)

| | Dear Friend,

Have you noticed how hard it is to make sense of arguments today?

Confident claims, especially with talking heads on television...quick reactions in comments online...everyone with strong opinions but not always clear thinking.

That's why we put together a **free Logic and Rhetoric Guide** --to help you think more clearly, evaluate the various opinions you hear and read daily, and make stronger, more persuasive arguments.

**You can download your free Logic and Rhetoric Guide here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkcFq3DAURb9G3tlITx5bXmhRqhkoNCkliy6NIr2xH8iSsKQp-fuSknxAtufCuVzun6f1yVKguD3bAzWVsvrk190-8C21mCo59CtwmHq-9EKs1lV64DrazusLCHVXHWoxq0WAgvnS7RqFuoCdnL17yXFxr0qOVi0L3oWUE7cd6XcfX4QQwEcJg_MLTLgoUP51BAA28pa9rThQLOSxuJRyToEquTKkc-uC3mvNhclvDG4MbhTvadgphOJtwAF9Y3ALaSPXnzvWdJLrS23-rd8aeWTyVhyThsM882cOI_y8GvPLXK_fGUytHmtJ7XTIpMlnKhldpbh9RAd6ageTBg9L4QM6e2RLW2TS_K_9xClWjJVJ83vuf7y89J_Lu1P7_JdCoDLNbOTbu2tw6ejql054aPgXAAD__wb6kko)

Inside, you'll discover how to:
* Recognize when an argument is sound, or when it falls apart

* Distinguish facts from opinions and emotional appeals

* Think more clearly before reacting

* Express your ideas more clearly and persuasively

In short, your guide will help you do something that's becoming increasingly rare: **Think clearly --and speak with confidence.**

And it's not just theory (although there's a lot of that in the guide)!

These are practical tools you can start using right away...in conversations, while watching the news, and in daily decisions.

**The guide is completely free, and you can read it at your own pace.**

And, if you want to go deeper, you can continue learning in Hillsdale College's full FREE online course, **" Classical Logic and Rhetoric."**

Trust me, the guide becomes even more helpful when you see these ideas explained by a Hillsdale faculty member in the full course.

**So, download your free Logic and Rhetoric Guide now:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkcFq3DAURb9G3tlITx5bXmhRqhkoNCkliy6NIr2xH8iSsKQp-fuSknxAtufCuVzun6f1yVKguD3bAzWVsvrk190-8C21mCo59CtwmHq-9EKs1lV64DrazusLCHVXHWoxq0WAgvnS7RqFuoCdnL17yXFxr0qOVi0L3oWUE7cd6XcfX4QQwEcJg_MLTLgoUP51BAA28pa9rThQLOSxuJRyToEquTKkc-uC3mvNhclvDG4MbhTvadgphOJtwAF9Y3ALaSPXnzvWdJLrS23-rd8aeWTyVhyThsM882cOI_y8GvPLXK_fGUytHmtJ7XTIpMlnKhldpbh9RAd6ageTBg9L4QM6e2RLW2TS_K_9xClWjJVJ83vuf7y89J_Lu1P7_JdCoDLNbOTbu2tw6ejql054aPgXAAD__wb6kko)

It's our gift to you. Part of our educational mission is to help more and more people understand what's true and communicate it clearly.

We hope you find it helpful.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

**P.S.** This short guide is a simple way to sharpen your thinking and improve your communication right away. Download your free copy here and get started:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkcFq3DAURb9G3tlITx5bXmhRqhkoNCkliy6NIr2xH8iSsKQp-fuSknxAtufCuVzun6f1yVKguD3bAzWVsvrk190-8C21mCo59CtwmHq-9EKs1lV64DrazusLCHVXHWoxq0WAgvnS7RqFuoCdnL17yXFxr0qOVi0L3oWUE7cd6XcfX4QQwEcJg_MLTLgoUP51BAA28pa9rThQLOSxuJRyToEquTKkc-uC3mvNhclvDG4MbhTvadgphOJtwAF9Y3ALaSPXnzvWdJLrS23-rd8aeWTyVhyThsM882cOI_y8GvPLXK_fGUytHmtJ7XTIpMlnKhldpbh9RAd6ageTBg9L4QM6e2RLW2TS_K_9xClWjJVJ83vuf7y89J_Lu1P7_JdCoDLNbOTbu2tw6ejql054aPgXAAD__wb6kko)

Oh, and after you browse the guide, you can continue with our free online course, **" Classical Logic and Rhetoric,"** for a deeper dive.

body:

Peter,
**If you’ve turned on the TV recently, you know the Republican midterm media frenzy is officially in full swing here in North Carolina.**
That’s why we’re rolling out a new survey to a select number of supporters to gauge how your news intake is impacting your view on our campaign, this Senate race and Roy Cooper himself. [_**We want to hear from you – so please: Will you fill out our quick survey before 11:59 p.m. tonight?**_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19554?code=email_su_pros_jtk1312&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=8&akid=3378%2E124072%2E91f_dQ)

---
It’s clear that Republicans are terrified of our grassroots momentum. Since launching a new multimillion-dollar attack ad campaign across broadcast, cable and streaming, the Senate GOP’s top super PAC is currently spending more in North Carolina than almost any other battleground state in the country.
With polls tightening, we worry their negative media investments are paying off – but as we enter the final leg of the race that will decide Senate control, we can’t leave anything up to chance.
The only way to know for sure is by hearing directly from the target audience: **viewers like you.**
[_**Please take two minutes to complete our Community Media Consumption Survey before the midnight deadline. Your feedback will give us the actionable insights we need to shape the narrative of this race and take back the Senate majority._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19554?code=email_su_pros_jtk1312&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=10&akid=3378%2E124072%2E91f_dQ)

We look forward to hearing from you, Peter. Thank you.

Team Cooper

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

name: Troy Carter
subject: I could be Louisiana’s last Black Congressman
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic State Central Committee of LA (louisianadems
body:
In April MAGA eliminated one of Louisiana’s only Black majority districts. They are working to erase my seat too. Right now we have a small window to stop MAGA’s plan to eliminate Black representation
| | | | | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010NC2h6evRxuiCifqzqDDlnSU6a7bzTeJcW7sC-X2jaoVGJCD5W_sYyC0tVExYQCBnFIqdqDGHK4HgJDrVZkrtyiCtF_UGTtcyrxjcDqXGg7rrSSR-r0A0GuuNJI0lhCItyyQyCWtPIkE5u3XFIQlViagnHNQ8hCOIMXZ7dd7hqjABMEZe3hgc2B7yG8g7JCZFrX9tLbdNH5TcYdC1lFvMmSHCk7GMqj4CFDRQUgiXOS9MIwQuU-7NQ==&c=vG-VvFlTQNthdplgAdE3F-2uhfZ8D8FWUBp1S8K49lNOeVxePAaiPQ==&ch=Fnd2NEkugk4dXruulK2YkmbrURVzp9AGEGz5R6C2vewYqt06EEmYjA==)
---
| Peter,
My name is Troy Carter, I'm the Democratic Congressman for Louisiana's 2nd congressional district, the last remaining majority-Black district in our state.
And if MAGA has its way, the district I represent will be the last ever majority-Black district in Louisiana. I could very well be Louisiana's last Black Congressman.
---
| | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010NC2h6evRxuiCifqzqDDlnSU6a7bzTeJcW7sC-X2jaoVGJCD5W_sYyC0tVExYQCBnFIqdqDGHK4HgJDrVZkrtyiCtF_UGTtcyrxjcDqXGg7rrSSR-r0A0GuuNJI0lhCItyyQyCWtPIkE5u3XFIQlViagnHNQ8hCOIMXZ7dd7hqjABMEZe3hgc2B7yG8g7JCZFrX9tLbdNH5TcYdC1lFvMmSHCk7GMqj4TOXQDyB8Xi_eAp7WTg693g==&c=vG-VvFlTQNthdplgAdE3F-2uhfZ8D8FWUBp1S8K49lNOeVxePAaiPQ==&ch=Fnd2NEkugk4dXruulK2YkmbrURVzp9AGEGz5R6C2vewYqt06EEmYjA==)
---
By now, you've heard about what MAGA did to Black voters in Louisiana.
In April, the Supreme Court restored Jim Crow style redistricting. In response, our MAGA governor declared a state of emergency to cancel our election, tossed out tens of thousands of ballots, and rammed through a brand-new map that erased one of our majority-Black districts -- the seat held by my colleague and dear friend Congressman Cleo Fields (D-LA).
And now, they're coming after my seat too. MAGA activists have challenged the very map their own legislature had passed, claiming the map that eliminated Cleo's seat didn't go far enough. They're trying to wipe out all Black representation in Louisiana.
But there is hope. Black voters, Democrats, and Louisianans across the state are pissed. They see what MAGA is trying to do, and they're turning out in historic numbers at the polls to get their payback.
In our May 16 election, Dems turned out in record numbers and delivered a blow that blindsided MAGA, sinking every single one of Governor Landry's amendments by 20 points or more. And now my good friend and Democratic Nominee for US Senate Jamie Davis is statistically TIED with MAGA candidate Julia Letlow in the latest poll on the race.
The tables have completely flipped. Instead of wiping out black representation in Louisiana, we're on the cusp of electing the state's first black Senator since Reconstruction.
---
| [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010NC2h6evRxuiCifqzqDDlnSU6a7bzTeJcW7sC-X2jaoVGJCD5W_sYyC0tVExYQCBnFIqdqDGHK4HgJDrVZkrtyiCtF_UGTtcyrxjcDqXGg7rrSSR-r0A0GuuNJI0lhCItyyQyCWtPIkE5u3XFIQlViagnHNQ8hCOIMXZ7dd7hqjABMEZe3hgc2B7yG8g7JCZFrX9tLbdNH5TcYdC1lFvMmSHCk7GMqj4XVJZ9GXt8bEQ6JSpkl4tPg==&c=vG-VvFlTQNthdplgAdE3F-2uhfZ8D8FWUBp1S8K49lNOeVxePAaiPQ==&ch=Fnd2NEkugk4dXruulK2YkmbrURVzp9AGEGz5R6C2vewYqt06EEmYjA==)
---

name: Fred Clark
subject: I was in the woods in Sauk County on 9/11. Here’s how I feel about that life-changing day:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Clark for Wisconsin Clark for Wisconsin
body:
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138977797/645843912/-2107098123?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjEwMzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTVkZTdhMWMtZGRhZC1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZjFkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0O3bO8f3taxnq28PLdA7NvgbJ_P2zuRhqVQIoOvoHmE=&emci=eb924c13-65ad-f111-9b33-0022482a933b&emdi=95de7a1c-ddad-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&ceid=28718937)
---
If you were alive on September 11, 2001, you remember where you were.

**I was working in the woods in Sauk County on 9/11, and when I heard the news I came inside to a nearby school and spent the next hour with a group of students watching the towers fall on television, all of us in disbelief. **

The stories of firefighters, EMS, and flight attendants responding to a catastrophe they never imagined with heroism and split-second decisions. And the stories of citizens on planes and on the ground who stood up, fought back, and jumped in to help -- that day truly reflected the best of us.

I remember in the weeks after 9/11 being at the Pentagon, standing with Republican State Senator Mary Lazich, and seeing that building with the huge hole where so many men and women in uniform and civilians had died.

And what struck me in the days and weeks after was the sense of unity we all felt as Americans, every one of us. The world was with us and we felt it.

So it’s worth asking: If a similar, horrific attack happened today, would we experience that same unity? Would we be prepared? Would our military, would our Federal Aviation Administration, and would our firefighters and first responders have what they needed to step up and save lives?

If we’re going to find that kind of unity again, we need a government as good as the people who served us on that day, and we need leaders who understand our government serves a higher purpose than engaging in political fights.

Let's recognize the anniversary of 9/11, for the people we lost and the people who served.

Thank you,

Fred Clark

_Nadia was only 15 years old when they went looking for her. _ A pastor had called House Parent Project, a children's home in Mexico. He knew Nadia was in danger. He even knew the Metro station in Mexico City where she could often be found.So the house parents went and they found her. But to understand what happened next, you need to know where Nadia came from. She never knew her father. Her mother lived an unstable and dangerous life, moving from one man to another. Nadia was the oldest of three little girls. Her youngest sister was given up for adoption. But Nadia grew up with almost nothing and no one. She survived on the streets of Mexico City, surrounded by drugs, prostitution, abandonment, and exploitation. Imagine being 15 years old and wondering if there is a single adult in this world you can trust. That was the girl they found near that Metro station. There was doubt in Nadia's eyes. But they asked her to give them a chance.

And Nadia shows what can happen when a child is not abandoned. A couple of years after her rescue, the team found Nadia's sister, Sofia. She was suffering through many of the same horrors. They rescued her too. Today, Sofia works full time caring for other children who have experienced the same kinds of brokenness. Then something beautiful happened in Nadia's life. She met Joseph, who had also grown up in the same Village - the House Parent Project community. They fell in love. They married, Joseph became a foreman, and the couple moved away for several years. They welcomed a son and daughter of their own. Yet they kept coming back for Christmas, Mother's Day, and birthdays. **Their hearts were still with the children. **Finally, in 2019, Nadia and Joseph came home permanently. Today, **they are second in command at one of the large children 's homes**. The child who once needed someone to find her**grew up to help care for children who need to be found. **That is**restoration**. That is **hope**. And that is why I am writing to you. Today, House Parent Project cares for, educates and protects **between 130 and 150 children in two homes, every single day**.

clean_body: The phone keeps ringing for children like Nadia A frightened 15-year-old was given a chance. See where she is today. | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Friend, Nadia was only 15 years old when they went looking for her. A pastor had called House Parent Project, a children's home in Mexico. He knew Nadia was in danger. He even knew the Metro station in Mexico City where she could often be found.So the house parents went and they found her. But to understand what happened next, you need to know where Nadia came from. She never knew her father. Her mother lived an unstable and dangerous life, moving from one man to another. Nadia was the oldest of three little girls. Her youngest sister was given up for adoption. But Nadia grew up with almost nothing and no one. She survived on the streets of Mexico City, surrounded by drugs, prostitution, abandonment, and exploitation. Imagine being 15 years old and wondering if there is a single adult in this world you can trust. That was the girl they found near that Metro station. There was doubt in Nadia's eyes. But they asked her to give them a chance. They told her something every child deserves to hear: You are loved. They promised to protect her and help her get an education. And Nadia willingly went with them. She left behind a horrible life and came home to parents who would raise her as their own. Friend, Nadia's story is one reason Sound of Freedom Foundation works with groups like House Parent Project.My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the movie Sound of Freedom because after learning what traffickers do to innocent children, I could not simply look away.For me, it stopped being a movie. It became a calling. Today, the Sound of Freedom Foundation carries that mission forward. Our mission is simple: Stop the sale of God 's children. House Parent Project shares that commitment. Their house parents give these children the love and care they've never known. And Nadia shows what can happen when a child is not abandoned. A couple of years after her rescue, the team found Nadia's sister, Sofia. She was suffering through many of the same horrors. They rescued her too. Today, Sofia works full time caring for other children who have experienced the same kinds of brokenness. Then something beautiful happened in Nadia's life. She met Joseph, who had also grown up in the same Village - the House Parent Project community. They fell in love. They married, Joseph became a foreman, and the couple moved away for several years. They welcomed a son and daughter of their own. Yet they kept coming back for Christmas, Mother's Day, and birthdays. Their hearts were still with the children. Finally, in 2019, Nadia and Joseph came home permanently. Today, they are second in command at one of the large children 's homes. The child who once needed someone to find hergrew up to help care for children who need to be found. That isrestoration. That is hope. And that is why I am writing to you. Today, House Parent Project cares for, educates and protects between 130 and 150 children in two homes, every single day. When it is safe, they work to restore children to healthy homes with family members. When that cannot happen, the homes may raise these children as their own until they grow up, get jobs, and go to college. More than 40 children that were residents stayed to become staff after they grew up. Others have grown up and married national pastors and missionaries. But there's a problem. The phone never stops ringing. There is always another child. Another crisis and another need. And the resources are slim. Providing three meals for one child costs about $4 a day. And that doesn't include clothes, shoes, diapers, or all the other things children need. Jesus said: " Let the little children come to me." (Matthew 19:14) I believe we have a duty to hear the cries of children who cannot protect themselves. Because when good people stay quiet, evil has room to grow. But when good people stand together,lives can change. Nadia is living proof. Friend, will you help us stand with House Parent Project and the house parents caring for children like Nadia today? "=" $25 can help feed a child fornearly a week $50 can help feed a child fornearly two weeks $100 can help feed a childfor25 days $200 can help**feedtwo children for 25 days That 's three meals every day. Maybe we cannot answer every call today. But together, we can help answer the next one. Please give now. And please pray for the children and for those caring for them. Share this mission with someone you love. Because this truth must be heard around the world: God 's children are not for sale. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. It costs about $4 to provide one child with three meals for one day**. body:

[We’re calling on every local Democrat to sign our letter DEMANDING the Postal Service protect vote-by-mail. Add your name before your spot expires at MIDNIGHT »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/130112?t=7&akid=28727%2E878179%2E4P3NuJ) | [TELL THE USPS TO PROTECT MAIL-IN VOTING BY SIGNING THE LETTER HERE »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/130112?t=8&akid=28727%2E878179%2E4P3NuJ)
---
TO: U.S. Postal Service
FROM: Willis
Subject: Please don’t cave to Trump.

Dear USPS,

**I am writing today to DEMAND that you stand up to Donald Trump and PROTECT vote-by-mail.**

Vote-by-mail has expanded voting access to millions of Americans in rural areas, serving overseas, and in marginalized communities.

Limiting access to states who do Trump’s bidding is UNDEMOCRATIC and straight up AUTHORITARIAN!

The Postal Service is a vital institution that has done so much good for our country — **so please don’t sacrifice everything you stand for now.**

[I’m signing this letter today to DEMAND you stand up to Trump and this disgusting attack on voting rights. Along with my signature, I’m chipping in $3 to the Voter Protection Project to ensure we flip the House this November and SAVE vote-by-mail »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/130112?t=9&akid=28727%2E878179%2E4P3NuJ) | [SIGN THE LETTER ASAP: DEMAND USPS PROTECT MAIL-IN VOTING »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/130112?t=10&akid=28727%2E878179%2E4P3NuJ)

**_X Willis_**
We can’t let Trump get away with this,

_The Voter Protection Project_
878179

**Friend of Life,** When Isabella told the father of her baby she was pregnant, she was hoping for encouragement. Instead, she received a single text message. **"Abort."** Already grieving the loss of her toddler's father to cancer, Isabella suddenly found herself carrying another child without the support she desperately needed. Fear quickly gave way to hopelessness, and she became convinced there was only one way out of the situation she was facing. Then something unexpected happened. Instead of making a permanent decision she could never take back, Isabella found her way to a PreBorn! Network Clinic, where she was welcomed with compassion and surrounded by people who cared about both her and her baby. They listened to her story, answered her questions, talked honestly about parenting and adoption, and shared the hope of Jesus Christ with her. As those conversations continued, our staff introduced Isabella to Cari and Christian, a couple who had spent years praying that God would bless them with the opportunity to adopt a little girl. Months later, when Isabella gave birth, she spent 80 precious hours holding her daughter before placing her into Cari and Christian's arms. Then she quietly said the words they will never forget: **"You are going to be parents to Liliana."** What Isabella didn't know was that Cari and Christian had already chosen that very name years earlier while praying for the daughter they hoped God would one day provide. Only God could write a story like that. Every day at PreBorn!, we meet women who believe their circumstances will define the rest of their lives. Time and again, God reminds us that His plans are often greater than anything we could imagine. Your generosity helps make those moments possible. A gift of **$28 helps provide one life-saving ultrasound** , giving another woman the opportunity to slow down, receive compassionate care, and hear that both she and her baby are deeply loved by Jesus Christ. And because of a generous matching challenge, **every gift made before September 30 will be MATCHED dollar for dollar, up to $100,000.** Will you help another woman discover that hope is never beyond God's reach?

New Yorker patriots marched in the streets of Manhattan Thursday **[demanding Mayor Zohran Mamdani not attend](https://substack.com/redirect/e8b1c0e9-1d1e-4f6e-b782-acc5f0b3db3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Friday's 9/11 ceremony and even clashed with left-wing counter protesters.
"The REAL victim of 9/11 was Mamdani's fake aunt?! We don't even know if she exists! He said she was to scared to wear her hijab on the subway after 9/11!" one anti-Mamdani protester told the crowd. "And let's talk about Islamophobia for a second! It is NOT irrational for me to fear them!"

* * *
# **Trump to mark 9/11 's 25th anniversary at Pentagon**
President Donald Trump will **[attend a 9/11 remembrance ceremony at the Pentagon](https://substack.com/redirect/305db5f2-4d34-44c2-baf6-6eb2a9ae68d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Friday, honoring victims and first responders, while Vice President JD Vance commemorates the anniversary at the World Trade Center site alongside former Presidents Obama, Bush, and Clinton, plus former NYC Mayor Rudy Giuliani.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/305db5f2-4d34-44c2-baf6-6eb2a9ae68d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The White House will have officials present at all three attack sites,** including Shanksville, Pennsylvania, marking Trump's continued pattern of attending Pentagon ceremonies during his presidency, as he did in 2017, 2019, and last year.
* **Ahead of the anniversary, the Tunnel to Towers Foundation displayed a recovered World Trade Center steel beam at the White House** as part of a cross-country tour; Trump, who witnessed the attacks from New York as a real estate developer, has previously described watching the towers from his office window.

* * *
# **JD Vance ignites the RNC with chilling speech: He 's ready for 2028...**
Vice President JD Vance **[drew"JD 28" chants](https://substack.com/redirect/af2fc425-1eed-487d-b240-51e944bc9820?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and enthusiastic crowd reactions at the GOP midterm convention's closing night, benefiting from a favorable speaking slot after Trump's Day 1 headliner and Marco Rubio's absence, though Vance urged focus on November first.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/af2fc425-1eed-487d-b240-51e944bc9820?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Vance handled a protester waving a Mexican flag by turning it into a rallying moment,** drawing praise from attendees who said the moment reinforced his presidential presence; he also urged disaffected conservatives frustrated over the Iran war not to abandon the party.
* **Multiple attendees said they left convinced Vance is ready to be the party 's next leader,** with some Republican officials calling his speech his best yet, even as Vance and Trump have both said it's too early to settle on a 2028 successor.
